Join us to bridge Earth science, data science, engineering, and decision analysis to help communities understand and manage evolving climate risks.

Because this work is interdisciplinary, strong technical training in applied math, machine learning, Earth science, and optimization is an important building block for your future research.
However, curiosity, critical thinking, and motivation to learn matter more than any specific training, and nobody has deep training across every domain.

To get a feel for the group, see our [values](/culture/values.qmd) and [expectations](/culture/expectations.qmd).
To start a conversation about a role, read the relevant page below and email James.
